title: festuca pumila var. wilczecziana
intro: Festuca pumila var. wilczecziana, commonly known as Alpgrass, is a type of grass species in the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca pumila var. wilczecziana include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and cardiovascular protective effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Festuca pumila var. wilczecziana have been reported to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its medicinal properties.
